title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your store information and subscription
accessControlHint: Control what each role can access
customFieldsEmptyWarning: Customer capture is on but no customer field is enabled. Cashiers will not be able to find or register customers at checkout. Enable at least one field (phone, plate…) below, or switch this off.
customFieldsHint: When enabled, the cashier can search for a customer or register a new one during a sale (POS).
kitchenAutoPrint: Auto-print the kitchen ticket after every sale
notificationPreferencesHint: Choose which notifications you want to receive by email. Security notifications (login and sessions) always stay on.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Program
loyalty.disabledHint: The loyalty program is currently disabled — no points are earned or redeemed on invoices. Enable it to show settings.
loyalty.tiersHint: Loyalty tiers grant a bonus points multiplier based on a customer's total lifetime points earned (not affected by redemption)

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.hint: Switch off the methods you do not accept. The POS shows only the enabled ones. Past invoices are not affected.
